 Order
The writ petition is being disposed of at the time of admission itself.

The writ petition has been filed seeking a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to take necessary actions for grant of compensation for the petitioner's land in Survey No.341/1A and Survey No.342/1A situated at Karagathahalli Village which shall include the damages, loss of living, loss of 420 yielding mango trees and 20 Kurunji trees and other pecuniary compensations, which are liable to be fixed under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Tamil Nadu Amendment) Act, 2014 along with interest.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Tamil Nadu Amendment) Act, 2014
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents has informed that the enquiry is under way and he has produced https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis a communication received from the Revenue Divisional Officer to the Government Advocate.
The enquiry is under way and notice under Section 19 (1) of the said Act has been issued to the petitioner and he was called for an enquiry on 18.09.2024.

Taking into account the fact that the enquiry is under way, the petitioner is directed to submit his objections to the 2nd respondent/Revenue Divisional Officer and the same shall be taken into consideration by the 2nd respondent.
It is needless to state that if the petitioner is not satisfied with the amount of compensation, it is well open to him to seek enhancement in the manner known to law.
3. With the above observations, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
The enquiry shall be completed within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
